text:
Sophie (AE): @channel Hi team — HexaFin (POC) asked for an ISO scope map, a signed pen-test letter that covers our hosted offering, and a short rundown of audit artifacts we can provide. They'd like this by Tue 2026-07-12. Can we confirm what we can deliver and who's POC? Thanks.
Mark (Solutions Eng): Hi — I can pull the ISO scope map and resource list. Pen-test letter: we can provide a vendor-signed letter + summary of findings redacted. Need to confirm scope: hosted API only or also Dedicated/Private?
Sophie (AE): Hosted API only. No Dedicated. Also they asked whether historical logs can be provided to their auditor (read-only).
Elaine (InfoSec): We don't hand raw logs. We can provide redacted summaries: auth logs, config snapshots, change control artifacts, SOC 2 report, and ISO control mapping. For pen-test letter we can supply a "letter of attestation" from our external vendor; we need customer name & intended use-case for the letter.
Dan (Customer Success): Timeline: if we have everything this week I can coordinate delivery by Mon 2026-07-11. Will that work for HexaFin?
Sophie (AE): They said auditor starts Aug 1, prefer docs earlier. Mon works.
Mark (Solutions Eng): Uploading draft scope map to internal bucket: https://redwood-internal.s3/iso/hexafin-scope-draft.pdf :thumbsup:
AuditBot: Document created by Mark (Solutions Eng): /compliance/iso/hexafin-scope-draft.pdf
Elaine (InfoSec): Quick question — does HexaFin require cross-border data residency attestation? If yes, we need to add region-specific controls to the scope. @Sophie (AE) can you confirm?
Sophie (AE): They said EU data only for PII. So yes, need eu-residency note.
Elaine (InfoSec): Got it. We'll include: data residency attestation (EU), SOC 2 Type II report summary, change control logs (redacted), pen-test attestation letter. I'll draft the pen-test letter — can someone confirm the exact product name we should use? Use "Redwood Hosted API (redwood-v1-prod)".
Mark (Solutions Eng): Confirmed product string. Also note: pen test performed 2025-10-16, vendor: SecureProbe Inc. We'll add scope block.
Sophie (AE): Could you add a one-line about our rolling key rotation policy? Auditor asked.
Elaine (InfoSec): Add: "CMK rotation schedule: quarterly; KMS vendor: AWS KMS; logs retained 13 months."
Mark (Solutions Eng): For the pen-test letter signature chain — do we send the vendor-signed PDF, or our signed statement + vendor contact?
Elaine (InfoSec): Vendor-signed PDF is preferred. I can request a vendor-signed artifact. Template below: 
```
From: SecureProbe Inc.
To: HexaFin / Auditor
Re: Penetration Test Attestation — Redwood Hosted API (redwood-v1-prod)
Date: 2025-10-20
We hereby attest that SecureProbe conducted a penetration test on Redwood's Hosted API ... [redacted summary].
Signed: SecureProbe Inc. (authorized rep)
```
Sophie (AE): Great. Can someone produce a single zip with: iso-scope, soc2-summary, pen-test-letter, and redacted logs? I can deliver to their SFTP.
Dan (Customer Success): I'll assemble the zip and put on secure transfer. Can we encrypt with password? Yes — we'll share password over phone.
Elaine (InfoSec): Link I'll provide will be internal temporary URL. Also record transfer in audit log.
Mark (Solutions Eng): FYI pricing note: if they request custom data extracts for the auditor (beyond summaries), that'll be billable engineering time — estimate 8-12 hours.
Sophie (AE): Noted — I'll flag potential charge to customer.
AuditBot: Checklist status updated: iso-scope (in-progress), soc2-summary (ready), pen-test-letter (pending vendor signature), transfer-package (pending).
Sophie (AE): Thanks team. I'll update HexaFin and request PO if they want custom extracts.
Elaine (InfoSec): I'll open a ticket with SecureProbe for the signed letter and cc compliance@redwood.com.
Mark (Solutions Eng): Ping me if you need specific logs redacted — I have the query templates.
Sophie (AE): Perfect. Closing out — will report back when package uploaded. :white_check_mark:
